# Sudoku project instructions

This repository contains a Python Flask Sudoku game in the starter folder.

Keep code readable and maintainable. Use small, reusable functions with clear names. Keep Sudoku generation and validation separate from Flask routes. Preserve existing behavior while refactoring.

Add tests before changing game logic, and run them after each feature. Handle invalid input consistently.

Use responsive plain CSS. Keep the game usable with a keyboard, and make text, controls, and focus indicators visible in both light and dark modes.
